# Notion Research Report

## Company Overview

- Notion was founded in 2013. [4]
- Notion is a privately held, venture capital-backed company. [4]
- Notion's founders include Ivan Zhao, Simon Last, and Akshay Kothari. [9]
- Notion Labs, Inc. was founded in San Francisco, California. [11]
- Notion's platform is an all-in-one workspace for writing, planning, collaborating, and organizing workflow. [4]
- Notion had 1,200 employees as of the latest data in the PitchBook profile. [4]
- Notion was formerly known as Canopy Technologies. [4]
- Notion's website is www.notion.com. [4]

## Industry Overview

- Notion operates in the collaborative workspace and productivity software industry, competing with companies like Microsoft, Atlassian, Airtable, Slack, ClickUp, monday.com, Asana, Coda, Obsidian, and Roam Research. [1]
- Notion views its competitors broadly — not as single-point solutions but as parts of a fragmented landscape it aims to unify, stating 'Our competitor is the entire industry.' [2]
- Microsoft launched Loop in November 2021 as a direct competitor to Notion, integrated into Microsoft 365. [3]
- Legacy note-taking tools like Evernote have declined (e.g., acquired for a fraction of former valuation by 2022), creating space for Notion’s rise amid shifting user expectations for integration and continuous improvement. [2]
- Enterprise incumbents such as Microsoft and Atlassian pose key competitive risks to Notion due to their existing distribution, embedded workflows, and offensive product launches like Microsoft Loop. [3]

## Financial Overview

- Notion reached a $2 billion valuation in 2020. [8]
- Notion raised $275 million in funding at a $10 billion valuation. [6]

## News

- Notion Labs, Inc. entered into a strategic collaboration with Keio University on February 25, 2026, to support Keio’s vision of becoming a 'Top Global AI-Native University' through integration of Notion AI tools for faculty and staff. [5]
- Notion AI integrated with ZoomInfo via GTM.AI’s Model Context Protocol (MCP) to enable go-to-market teams to query account and buying committee data directly in Notion AI chat. [7]
- Sia Partners acquired Notion Consulting — a US-based organizational change consulting firm founded in 2015 — to expand its Change Management & Organization capabilities in the US East region. [10]

# Figma Research Report

## Company Overview

- Figma, Inc. develops and sells a collaborative, browser-based platform for designing, prototyping, building digital experiences, and subscriptions for access to its platform. [8]
- Figma Design was launched in 2015 using WebGL technology to bring design into the browser for the first time. [9]
- FigJam was launched in 2021. [9]
- Dev Mode was launched in 2023. [9]
- Figma Slides was introduced in 2024. [9]
- Figma was incorporated in 2012. [8]
- Figma is headquartered in San Francisco, California. [8]
- Figma completed its IPO in July 2025. [11]
- Figma has 1,886 employees. [11]
- Figma's stock symbol is FIG. [11]

## Industry Overview

- Figma operates in the Collaborative Design And Prototyping category. [2]
- Figma's primary competitors in UI/UX design and prototyping include Sketch, InVision, and Adobe XD. [3]
- Figma's top competitors in the Collaborative Design And Prototyping category are Adobe Discover (18.96% market share), Adobe Premiere Pro CC (16.33%), and Adobe XD (9.33%). [2]
- Figma is a collaborative design platform. [5]
- Figma competes with Adobe, Canva, Framer, Lucidspark, Miro, Mural, Penpot, Sketch, UxPin, Axure, and InVision. [5]

## Financial Overview

- Figma's revenue for the third quarter of 2025 was $274.2 million, representing a 38% year-over-year increase. [1]
- Figma reported a GAAP net loss of $(1.1) billion for the third quarter of 2025, largely due to a one-time stock-based compensation expense of $975.7 million related to its IPO. [1]
- Figma's non-GAAP net income for the third quarter of 2025 was $62.4 million. [1]
- Figma's Net Dollar Retention Rate for customers with ARR of $10,000 or more was 131% as of September 30, 2025. [1]
- Figma raised $200 million at a $10 billion valuation. [10]

## News

- Figma announced a partnership with Anthropic on February 17, 2026, to launch a feature called "Code to Canvas" that converts code generated by AI tools like Claude Code into editable designs in Figma. [6]
- Figma works with OpenAI through a ChatGPT and FigJam integration. [4]
- Figma added an AI assistant to its collaborative canvas that responds to natural language prompts to generate or edit designs and automate tasks, powered by design-fine-tuned AI models. [7]

# Stripe Research Report

## Company Overview

- Stripe Inc is a fintech company that provides payment software services and solutions for online merchants. [2]
- Stripe was founded in 2009 by Irish brothers Patrick and John Collison. [7]
- Stripe is headquartered in San Francisco, California, US. [2]
- Stripe operates offices in the US, the UK, Ireland, and Tokyo. [2]
- Stripe's customers include Amazon, Google, and Shopify. [7]
- Stripe raised $2.2 billion in funding from investors including Sequoia, General Catalyst, Founders Fund, and Thrive. [7]
- Stripe's latest valuation is $107 billion, based on a share sale to employees in September 2025. [7]
- In the four days from Black Friday to Cyber Monday in 2025, Stripe processed over $40 billion in transactions. [7]

## Industry Overview

- Stripe's top competitors in the payment management category are PayPal (29.98% market share), Venmo (8.70%), and Adyen (8.59%). [4]
- Stripe holds a 34.51% market share in the payment-management market. [4]
- Stripe has 645,495 companies using it as a payment management tool globally as of 2026, with 53.66% (291,721) based in the United States. [4]
- Stripe leads among high-growth technology companies and developers who value sophisticated APIs and rapid innovation, while PayPal dominates among established marketplaces and consumer-facing businesses. [3]
- 45% of U.S. ecommerce businesses use Stripe as their primary payment processor. [3]
- 62% of Fortune 500 companies use Stripe for payment processing. [3]
- Stripe’s competitors include PayPal (Braintree), Square, Adyen, Checkout.com, FIS, Razorpay (India), and Xendit (Indonesia). [1]

## Financial Overview

- Stripe's valuation was $95 billion following a funding round in which it raised $600 million. [9]
- Stripe was valued at $159 billion in a tender offer for employees and shareholders, representing a more than 70% increase from a similar share sale a year earlier. [10]
- Stripe's valuation was $9.2 billion in a funding round completed around 2016 (as inferred from the article's timestamp of 2016-11-24, though the URL shows 2026 erroneously). [11]

## News

- Stripe announced 288 new products and features at its annual Stripe Sessions conference while building economic infrastructure for AI. [5]
- Stripe partnered with Google to enable product purchases within Google’s Gemini AI search and app as part of its agentic commerce initiative. [8]
- Stripe partnered with Hong Kong–based fintech PhotonPay to widen payment method offerings, reinforce uptime, and simplify technical adoption for merchants. [6]
- Stripe expanded its Agentic Commerce Suite to include integrations with OpenAI, Microsoft, Meta, and now Google — enabling in-app purchases inside AI agents across these platforms. [8]
- Stripe opened its Link consumer digital wallet to AI agents, allowing users to authorize agents to make payments on their behalf. [8]

# Airbnb Research Report

## Company Overview

- Airbnb, Inc. operates a global platform for stays and experiences. [7]
- Airbnb Inc operates a global marketplace that connects guests with hosts offering stays, experiences, and services. [9]
- Airbnb's legal name is Airbnb, Inc. [11]
- Airbnb is headquartered in San Francisco, CA, United States. [11]
- Airbnb was founded in 2007. [11]
- Airbnb has a presence in over 220 countries and regions worldwide. [11]
- Airbnb's business model is B2C. [11]
- Airbnb's industry is Software Development. [11]

## Industry Overview

- Airbnb's biggest competitor by market share among major online travel agencies is Booking.com, which holds around 18% of the short-term rental market compared to Airbnb's 44%, according to Skift’s 2026 short-term rental report. [3]
- Airbnb, Booking.com, and HomeAway lead the paid peer-to-peer accommodation market with seven, five, and two million listings respectively, operating in 190, 227, and 160 countries. [2]
- Other major competitors to Airbnb include Vrbo, Expedia Group, HomesToGo/Tripping.com, Furnished Finder, Plum Guide, and HipCamp. [1]
- In the US tourist accommodation market, Airbnb held 19% market share in 2018, up from a negligible share in 2013, while hotel market share dropped from 94% to 70% over the same period. [2]
- Vrbo holds roughly 9% of the short-term rental market, according to Skift’s 2026 short-term rental market report. [3]

## Financial Overview

- Airbnb reported revenue of $859 million for the fourth quarter of 2020, representing a 22% year-over-year decline. [4]
- Airbnb lost $3.9 billion in the fourth quarter of 2020. [4]
- Airbnb's gross booking value was $5.9 billion in the fourth quarter of 2020, down 31% year-over-year. [4]
- Airbnb's revenue fell 67% in the quarter ending June 30, 2020. [4]
- Airbnb's total revenue is $11,943,000,064. [5]
- Airbnb's EBITDA is $2,760,999,936. [5]
- Airbnb's total debt is $2,278,000,128. [5]
- Airbnb's net income to common is $2,631,000,064. [5]
- Airbnb's price to book is 1.46. [5]
- Airbnb's enterprise to revenue is 0.39. [5]
- Airbnb's enterprise to EBITDA is 1.67. [5]

## News

- American Express and Airbnb launched an exclusive partnership, bringing over one million Airbnb listings to Amex Travel. [6]
- Airbnb.org announced partnerships with Fisher House Foundation and Operation Healing Forces to provide free stays for service members, veterans, and their families traveling for medical treatment. [8]
- Airbnb partnered with Tripadvisor to bring a selection of Tripadvisor experiences to the Airbnb platform, with certain tours, activities, and attractions available to book on Airbnb later in 2026. [10]
